players.product: HV / MV / LV power cable, Cu / Al rod and busduct (Vietnam subsidiaries LS-VINA and LS Cable & System Vietnam)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, filed 08-14-2026, consolidated, KRW): Q2 2026 revenue KRW 350,271,469,180 vs KRW 250,235,674,686 in Q2 2025; Q2 operating profit KRW 25,256,211,365 vs KRW 23,593,793,137; H1 2026 revenue KRW 635,750,810,528 vs KRW 478,577,227,094; H1 operating profit KRW 45,359,248,357 vs KRW 38,930,324,388; H1 net income KRW 33,372,462,074 vs KRW 30,918,012,536. Subsidiaries (before eliminations): LS-VINA revenue KRW 650,431,391 thousand with operating profit KRW 37,901,305 thousand (power cable KRW 251,274M, Cu / Al rod materials KRW 379,001M); LS Cable & System Vietnam revenue KRW 152,019,866 thousand with operating profit KRW 9,363,556 thousand. Average LME copper USD 13,088 per tonne in H1 2026 vs USD 9,939 in 2025.

Capacity and utilisation H1 2026 (half-year report): LS-VINA (Haiphong) power cable (HV / MV / LV) capacity 731,669 km, output 614,602 km, utilisation 84%; Cu / Al rod 62,400 t capacity, 33,015 t output, 53%. LS Cable & System Vietnam (Dong Nai) busduct 10,800 sets capacity and 10,800 sets built, utilisation 100%; MV / LV cable 72%; UTP cable 39%; optical cable 11%. Planned equipment investment: LS-VINA USD 5,948 thousand (expansion and efficiency, USD 527 thousand spent in 2026) and LS Cable & System Vietnam USD 1,985 thousand.

quarterly_data.signal: Order book at 2026-06-30 (half-year report): orders for 2025-2026 total KRW 1,047,999M, of which KRW 802,451M delivered, leaving an order backlog of KRW 245,548M - LS-VINA (power cable and Cu / Al rod) KRW 211,492M and LS Cable & System Vietnam (communication cable, MV / LV cable, busduct) KRW 34,056M.
quarterly_data.figure: order backlog KRW 245,548M (LS-VINA KRW 211,492M; LS Cable & System Vietnam KRW 34,056M) at 2026-06-30

quarterly_data.signal: Data-center business (half-year report): the company supplied extra-high-voltage cable to a data center in Indonesia (September 2025) and busduct to data centers in Indonesia (October 2025) and Malaysia (March 2026), and says data-center busduct and extra-high-voltage cable orders are already generating revenue; over the next year it plans to pursue busduct and extra-high-voltage cable orders in the global data-center market including Vietnam. The report also says LS Cable & System Vietnam's communication-cable orders are rising on North American data-center investment, and describes AI data centers as a driver of high-capacity power-grid cable demand.

Rare-earth metal business (half-year report): on 03-26-2026 LS Eco Energy signed a binding framework agreement with Lynas Rare Earths to receive rare-earth oxide from Lynas and to set up a rare-earth metal manufacturing subsidiary in Vietnam, cooperating with Lynas on metallization; an oxide supply contract is still being negotiated, and the metal plant is to be built on LS Cable & System Vietnam's site with about KRW 28.5 billion of planned investment (board plan of 12-17-2025). The two companies completed an exchange of convertible bonds in August 2026 as the first step of the partnership. An earlier 500 t a year oxide purchase contract with Vietnamese miner HungThinh Mineral (January 2024) has not delivered. [partnership; signed 03-26-2026]
quarterly_data.figure: about KRW 28.5 billion planned rare-earth metal plant investment; framework agreement 03-26-2026
